_comment: Torrente water style 'Lagoon' (0.5.0): very clear water with bright blues, turquoise shallows, sharp and lively caustics, and a colour that follows the sky and fog around it (warm at sunset, grey under overcast, deep blue at night). Original values. Override by shipping assets/torrente/styles/lagoon.json in a resource pack; colours are #RRGGBB.
